messages:
maya: heads up — noticed inconsistent error surfaces after the auth/backoff change. python sdk raises AuthError with .retryable=False, js sdk returns ApiError('401') and the retry flag is missing. onboarding sample app breaks.
alex: hmm, can you paste an example?
maya: yes — python:
```py
try:
  client.chat.create(...)
except AuthError as e:
  print(e.message, e.retryable)  # False
```
js:
```js
try {
  await client.chat.create(...)
} catch (e) {
  console.error(e) // ApiError: 401 Unauthorized (no .retryable)
}
```
maya: result is our platform retry middleware treats python as non-retryable and js ends up using default transient retry which retries 401s wrongly.
raj: that's bad. 401 should be non-retryable. 429/503 should be retryable. We need a canonical mapping: 401 -> AuthError, 403 -> PermissionError, 404 -> NotFound, 429 -> RateLimitError(with retry_after), 500 -> ServerError, 503 -> ServiceUnavailable.
maya: agreed. also request adding structured fields on the error payload: error.code (string), error.retryable (bool), error.retry_after (int|null), and raw_status.
tessa: +1 on structured fields. That will make parity easy across SDKs.
alex: Implementation question: keep top-level typed exceptions (class hierarchy) and include structured metadata on the exception instance? or only structured payload in error body?
maya: prefer both: typed exceptions for ergonomics and structured fields for programmatic policies. i can draft a sample app showcasing a retry policy that consumes both.
raj: also need to wire server side to set a standard header (prefer Retry-After) or include retry_after in the body for 429. some clients prefer header-based flow.
tessa: note: some customers use builtin http client libs; strongly prefer `Retry-After` header to be standard.
maya: I'll open a tiny sample app showing how to adapt backoff to either header or body and normalise errors across SDKs: https://github.com/redwood/devex-error-sample
alex: can we add a lint rule in sdks to fail builds if exceptions don't expose `.error_code` and `.retryable`?
raj: let's start with conformance tests: add a CI test that asserts mapping for 401/403/404/429/500/503 across python/js/go. if tests pass we can add linter later.
deploy-bot: scheduled a canary deploy to staging at 10:15 UTC — will log any 5xx spikes.
tessa: action items: maya to PR sample app, raj to add conformance tests across repos, alex to draft SDK change proposal, tessa to file product note on user-facing error copy. i'll create ticket DEVEX-321.
maya: created PR #142 in devex-error-sample and linked to DEVEX-321.
alex: i'll take the SDK proposal, pinged #eng-sdk for review.
raj: i'll add CI tests in go/js/python repos.
tessa: thanks — this will cut down onboarding confusion. :thumbsup:
maya: one more thing — please make sure streaming endpoints include same error shape (we currently get bare newline messages in stream). small but surfaces often during live demos.
alex: noted for the runtime team, will follow up with eng-runtime.
maya: thanks all.
